interpretation.rule: Snapshots each contain an overlapping current-date-minus-14 through current-date reporting sample. NEVER add consecutive snapshot counts together.
interpretation.gap: No snapshot for a date means the collection history is missing, not that no biological activity was observed.
interpretation.privacy: Only broad regional samples, reporting-unit counts, and public species names are stored; no personal or site coordinates.
interpretation.sourcePolicy: USA-NPN and iNaturalist sampled reports only. Source outages and capped queries are represented explicitly.
interpretation.start: Archival collection begins from the first actual dated snapshot; historical raw observations are not reconstructed from rolling totals.
